headline: Colts' Keenan Allen formally charged, faces two misdemeanors
summary: Colts wide receiver Keenan Allen was formally charged with two misdemeanor drunken driving charges on Wednesday.

headline: Travis Kelce was a victim in a Ponzi scheme
summary: Two years after Chiefs tight end Travis Kelce was the direct victim of thievery via a burglary at his home, it has come to light that he was robbed in a different way.

headline: Giants expect Aaron Donald to play on Monday night
summary: Rams head coach Sean McVay said on Monday that the team has not decided whether defensive tackle Aaron Donald will play in Week 2, but the opposing head coach believes he knows the answer.
